instruction: In the first slide, insert the title "Summer Vacation" and set the font size to 36pt.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully inserted title 'Happy Family' on slide 1 and changed font to Microsoft JhengHei. Used terminal to verify font availability (fc-list | grep -i jhenghei), then typed text and set font in LibreOffice Impress.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can click on title placeholder, type text, change font via font selector, use terminal for font verification, navigate LibreOffice Impress UI
metadata.task_rationale: Variation of the original task: same text insertion pattern but with a different title and font size change instead of font family change. Tests the agent's ability to modify font size, a related but distinct formatting operation.
metadata.explanation: Task requires inserting title text and setting font size to 36pt. Getter extracts title text and font size from slide 1's title placeholder. Metric gives 0.5 for correct text and 0.5 for correct font size.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly identifies title placeholder (type 1) on slide 0 (first slide) and extracts both title text and font size in points
Metric correctly handles expected parameter directly (no incorrect 'rules' nesting), checking both title text and font size
Full coverage: both instruction requirements (title text 'Summer Vacation' and font size 36pt) are verified with appropriate partial credit (0.5 each)
Postconfig saves the file (Ctrl+S) before getter reads it, ensuring state freshness
Expected values ('Summer Vacation', 36) match instruction exactly
Font size tolerance of ±0.5pt and case-insensitive text comparison are reasonable
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Getter only reads font size from the first run of the first non-empty paragraph. If text has mixed formatting across runs, it may miss inconsistencies. For this simple task this is acceptable.
